scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev --workspace apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build:web:tauri: cross-env BUILD_TARGET=tauri npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
